threshold_rationale.selected_measure: Treasury Total Interest-bearing Debt average interest rate
threshold_rationale.rationale: Net-interest adequacy and resilience floors should prevent a fiscal path from being treated as admissible if reviewed policy and stress evidence raise the average rate on total interest-bearing debt above the latest source-custodied Treasury baseline before debt stock, maturity, primary-balance feedback, and fiscal-year projection bridges are complete.
threshold_rationale.source_table: Treasury Fiscal Data average interest rates latest record date 2026-06-30

primary_baseline.measure: Total Interest-bearing Debt average interest rate

supporting_context.measure: FY2025 OMB PBD net-interest outlay context
FY2031 OMB PBD projected net-interest outlay context

source_custody.publisher: Bureau of the Fiscal Service, U.S. Department of the Treasury

baseline_values.boundary: The average-rate baseline is net-interest adequacy and resilience context only. It is not a complete fiscal-year rate path, not a debt-stock projection, not a maturity schedule, not primary-balance feedback, not a direct net-interest cut, not a federal policy score, not gross savings, not net savings, not solver input, not a rate calculation, not a public rate card, and not a balanced-budget claim.

remaining_requirements: pass/fail evidence comparing policy and stress values with the threshold
